surface: Settings → Advanced agent capabilities → Audit key
title: Audit-key load, export, and rotation failures lack actionable UI
reproduction: In an isolated component test, reject the audit details read during the actual Advanced agent capabilities mount: the original card remains at loading and raises an unhandled rejection.
Reject clipboard writing after Export public key: the original card logs a warning but renders no failure or retry.
Let rotation succeed but reject its follow-up details read: the original handler raises an unhandled rejection and gives no honest rotation outcome.

At the real storage boundary, let the active-key write persist then reject: the original primitive throws after the key has changed, so the UI can invite another rotation. Initial key creation has the same partial-write seam.
expected: Every failure is visible with an action that retries only the failed operation. A successful rotation remains acknowledged when its refresh fails; retrying details never rotates again.
actual: The component initially had no failure state; load and rotation refresh rejected outside a catch, while export caught only to console. The primitive wrote history, active key, and imported key sequentially, so a late rejection could obscure a persisted key change.
severity: S2: admin cannot tell whether key rotation succeeded or recover failed reads and copy

transition_history.reason: Guarded connected-component red run reproduced three missing failure outcomes.

Source repair committed; native acceptance remained pending.
